name: scyl
description: SCYL. Songs Change Your Life. A portrait music player with two tactile dials and YouTube listening sets.

scripts.check: node --check app.mjs && node --check privacy.mjs && node --check lib/native-export.mjs && node --check lib/native-lifecycle.mjs && node --check server.mjs && node --check scripts/build-web.mjs && node --check scripts/install-native-icons.mjs && node --check scripts/third-party-notices.mjs
scripts.native:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.native:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
